research_question: What geospatial datasets are available to characterize the Savannah reservoir system watershed, reservoir morphometry, and physical basin properties?
task_prompt: Search for watershed delineation data for the Savannah River basin above J. Strom Thurmond Dam, including Hartwell Lake and Richard B. Russell Lake. Find reservoir morphometric data: area-volume-depth (hypsometric) curves, bathymetric surveys, maximum and mean depth, shoreline length for Hartwell, Russell, and Thurmond. Look for USGS StreamStats data for the Savannah River above the reservoir cascade. Find DEM data (SRTM 30m or 3DEP 10m) covering Hartwell, Russell, and Thurmond. Look for USACE technical reports on reservoir sedimentation surveys that include bathymetric data for the Savannah system. Target sources: USGS StreamStats, USACE Savannah District reports, USGS EarthExplorer (earthexplorer.usgs.gov), USACE National Inventory of Dams. Also search: "J. Strom Thurmond reservoir morphometry" "Hartwell Lake bathymetry" "Richard B Russell Lake bathymetry" "Savannah River basin delineation USGS".

research_question: What land cover and land use data exist for the Savannah River watershed upstream of Thurmond Dam, and how has it changed over time?
task_prompt: Search for NLCD (National Land Cover Database) data covering the Savannah River basin upstream of Thurmond Dam, including the Hartwell and Russell sub-basins. Target NLCD years: 2001, 2006, 2011, 2016, 2019, 2021 (change detection). Key land cover classes for this region: deciduous forest, evergreen forest, mixed forest, cultivated crops, pasture/hay, woody wetlands, developed areas. Find watershed-level land cover summaries if available (% forest, % agriculture). Search for Georgia and South Carolina agricultural statistics (USDA NASS) for counties in the watershed: McDuffie, Columbia, Lincoln, Wilkes (GA); McCormick, Edgefield (SC), plus counties around Hartwell and Russell. Also look for USGS or USACE reports on non-point source pollution from agricultural areas in the watershed affecting the reservoir system. Target sources: MRLC.gov (NLCD), USDA NASS, Georgia DNR, DES/SC agencies. Queries: "NLCD Savannah River watershed" "land use Savannah reservoir system" "Hartwell watershed land cover" "Richard B Russell watershed land use".

research_question: What long-term climate and precipitation data are available for the Savannah reservoir system region (Georgia-South Carolina Piedmont)?
task_prompt: Search for precipitation and temperature records covering the Savannah River basin upstream of Thurmond Dam. Target NOAA Climate Data Online (CDO) stations near the system: Augusta, GA (GHCND:USW00003820), Hartwell region, Clarks Hill, SC, McCormick, SC, and Thomson, GA. Look for monthly and annual precipitation normals and anomalies (1991-2020 normal). Search for drought index data (PDSI, SPI) for the region - relevant for explaining pool elevation variability and low inflow periods. Find PRISM or Daymet gridded climate data for the watershed. Search for studies linking precipitation patterns to inflow and pool level fluctuations across Hartwell, Russell, and Thurmond. Target sources: NOAA CDO (ncdc.noaa.gov/cdo-web), PRISM Climate Group, Daymet (daymet.ornl.gov), SE Climate Consortium. Queries: "precipitation Savannah River basin" "drought Clarks Hill Lake" "Hartwell reservoir drought" "Georgia Piedmont climate hydrology".

research_question: What operational data (pool elevation, storage volume, inflow, outflow, releases) does USACE publish for the Hartwell-Russell-Thurmond reservoir system?
task_prompt: Search for USACE Savannah District water management data for Hartwell Dam, Richard B. Russell Dam, and J. Strom Thurmond Dam. Find the official portal for daily pool elevation (ft MSL) and storage volume (acre-ft) for all three reservoirs, not only Thurmond. Look for historical pool elevation records - ideally 10+ years daily data. Find inflow and outflow (powerhouse + spillway) discharge records for the cascade. Search the USACE AquaLink Water Control Data System (water.usace.army.mil) for Hartwell, Russell, and Thurmond station codes and data download options. Find USACE Water Control Manual or Master Plan documents that explain coordinated operation across the three reservoirs. Look for seasonal pool management patterns and evidence of upstream regulation propagating into Thurmond operations. Target sources: sas.usace.army.mil (Savannah District), water.usace.army.mil (AquaLink), USACE published reports. Queries: "Hartwell lake operations data" "Richard B Russell dam pool elevation" "Clarks Hill Dam water control" "J. Strom Thurmond pool elevation data" "USACE Savannah District reservoir operations data download" "Savannah River cascade reservoir operations".

research_question: What streamflow and inflow data are available from USGS and NWS for the Savannah River cascade and tributaries affecting Hartwell, Russell, and Thurmond?
task_prompt:
START HERE: Examine the two preferred data endpoints for this study: 1) NWS SERFC Clarks Hill Dam inflows: https://www.weather.gov/serfc/inflows_chds1
   - find what historical data format is available, download options, and time period.
2) USGS monitoring location 02193900: https://waterdata.usgs.gov/monitoring-location/USGS-02193900/
   - identify the parameter codes available (discharge, stage, water quality),
   the period of record, and how to access data via USGS NWIS API.
Also search for other USGS gauges that support the three-reservoir system: - inflow and stage context for Hartwell Lake - inflow and stage context for Richard B. Russell Lake - Savannah River, Little River, and Stevens Creek tributaries relevant to Thurmond Find the USGS NWIS REST API endpoints for daily discharge data (parameter 00060) and stage data (parameter 00065) for the identified gauges. Document the data format (JSON/RDB/CSV) and time series coverage. Target sources: waterdata.usgs.gov/nwis, water.weather.gov/ahps, https://www.weather.gov/serfc/inflows_chds1. Queries: "USGS 02193900 Savannah River discharge" "NWS SERFC CHDS1 inflow data" "Hartwell Lake USGS inflow" "Richard B Russell Lake USGS gauge" "Savannah River cascade inflow historical USGS".

research_question: What is the estimated water residence time of Thurmond Lake, and how is it conditioned by the upstream Hartwell-Russell-Thurmond operating cascade?
task_prompt: Search for published estimates of water residence time (hydraulic retention time) for Clarks Hill Lake / J. Strom Thurmond Reservoir. Formula reference: TR = Volume (m3) / Outflow (m3/day). Reservoir capacity: ~2.8 km3 (2.26 million acre-ft) at full pool. Look for studies that model spatial variation in residence time within the lake (riverine zone near inflow vs lacustrine zone near dam), but also look for operational papers or manuals that explain how Hartwell and Russell regulation modifies Thurmond throughput. Find USACE or academic studies on thermal stratification and mixing regimes in Clarks Hill - relevant to low-energy depositional zone identification. Search for hydrodynamic models applied to Clarks Hill (CE-QUAL-W2 or similar). Key concept for the research: low-energy zones (longer residence time) correspond to fine-sediment accumulation zones where iron and organic carbon concentrate. Target sources: Google Scholar, USACE technical reports, USGS Water Resources Investigation Reports. Queries: "Clarks Hill Lake residence time" "J. Strom Thurmond hydraulic retention" "Hartwell Russell Thurmond operations residence time" "Savannah River reservoir hydrodynamics stratification" "CE-QUAL-W2 Thurmond Lake" "Clarks Hill Lake mixing".

research_question: What historical water quality data (DO, pH, temperature, turbidity, nutrients, chlorophyll-a) exist for monitoring stations across Hartwell, Russell, and Thurmond?
task_prompt: Search the EPA Water Quality Portal (waterqualitydata.us) for sampling data at Hartwell Lake, Richard B. Russell Lake, and J. Strom Thurmond Reservoir. Use site type "Lake, Reservoir, Impoundment" and location filters for Georgia/South Carolina near the reservoir system. Find USGS NWIS water quality data (parameter codes: 00300 DO, 00400 pH, 00010 temperature, 00076 turbidity, 00665 total phosphorus, 00618 nitrate, 32209 chlorophyll-a) at or near the three reservoirs. Search for Georgia EPD monitoring data for the Savannah system. Search for South Carolina water-quality assessments on the South Carolina side. Find any long-term trophic state assessments (TSI, Carlson's index) for Thurmond and any supporting records for Hartwell and Russell. Target sources: waterqualitydata.us, waterdata.usgs.gov/nwis, epd.georgia.gov, des.sc.gov. Queries: "Clarks Hill Lake water quality EPA" "Hartwell lake DO nutrients" "Richard B Russell reservoir chlorophyll" "Georgia EPD Savannah reservoir monitoring".

research_question: What is the documented history of algal blooms and eutrophication concerns across the Savannah reservoir system, especially at Thurmond?
task_prompt: Search for documented algal bloom events at Clarks Hill Lake / J. Strom Thurmond Reservoir and any related upstream reservoir records for Hartwell and Russell. The study explicitly identifies "periodic algal bloom concern" as a key motivation. Find USACE, EPA, or state agency reports on cyanobacteria blooms in the system. Search for harmful algal bloom advisories issued by Georgia EPD or South Carolina agencies. Find nutrient loading estimates (nitrogen, phosphorus) from the watershed - relevant to internal nutrient loading from sediments. Search for any total maximum daily load (TMDL) studies linked to the Savannah cascade. Look for publications on seasonal dissolved oxygen depletion patterns, which connect to iron mobilization from sediments. Target sources: Georgia EPD, EPA ATTAINS, Google Scholar, USACE Savannah District environmental reports. Queries: "Clarks Hill Lake algal bloom cyanobacteria" "J. Strom Thurmond eutrophication" "Hartwell reservoir algal bloom" "Savannah River reservoir nutrient loading".

research_question: What academic studies have investigated sediment transport, deposition, and geochemistry in Thurmond Lake and comparable southeastern US Piedmont reservoirs, including system-level links to Hartwell and Russell operations?
task_prompt: Search for peer-reviewed literature on sediment dynamics at Clarks Hill Lake or J. Strom Thurmond Reservoir - particularly studies on: - suspended sediment concentrations and transport - sedimentation rates and trap efficiency - spatial distribution of sediment types (fine vs coarse) - iron geochemistry in reservoir sediments - organic carbon storage in reservoir sediments Search for comparable studies in southeastern US Piedmont reservoirs that share similar watershed geology (granite/gneiss, kaolinitic soils) with Thurmond. Search for studies or technical reports explaining how upstream regulation by Hartwell and Russell modifies depositional and hydrodynamic conditions in Thurmond. Search for USACE sedimentation surveys for Clarks Hill Dam. Relevant keyword combinations: "Clarks Hill Lake sediment", "J. Strom Thurmond sedimentation", "Hartwell Russell Thurmond operations sediment", "Piedmont reservoir iron sediment Georgia", "southeastern reservoir iron organic carbon", "reservoir sediment trap efficiency Savannah River", "iron organic matter coupling freshwater sediment southeastern US". Target sources: Google Scholar, USACE Technical Reports (ERDC), Journal of Soils and Sediments, Limnology and Oceanography, Geochimica et Cosmochimica Acta.
